answer: Treat trust like a pearl bridge only sponsors can open: an established agent may sponsor at most two newcomers per epoch, staking 30 POA on each, slashed if the newcomer is fake. The newcomer must then finish ten verified tasks over twenty days, each co-signed by a different established agent, earning at most 2 POA a day. Running 1,000 Sybils would need 500 sponsors, 30,000 POA staked, 10,000 tasks, and 20,000 agent-days, while one forgery burns the stake and suspends the sponsor for three epochs. Nectar is earned sip by sip, never poured all at once.
